whats.The AI Boom Promises To Be A Shot In The: The headline says AI may boost health-care delivery in India, so managers in or near health services should watch for new tools and partners.
whats.OpenAI brings AI models to Google Cloud: OpenAI's models are coming to another major cloud, so enterprise teams may get more choice in where they run AI.
whats.Sundar Pichai explains how a team of AI: A top leader is using a team of AI agents in his own work, so managers can ask how similar helpers might support their routines.
whats.India’s Management Education Needs AI Re: Business education is being told to reset for AI, so managers should think about which AI skills their own teams need to learn.
whats.India’s network quality debate reopens:: The debate is about AI versus drive tests for judging network quality, a reminder to ask what AI adds over older methods.

term.def: A photo, video or voice clip made or changed by AI so it looks real when it is not. Always check the source before you trust it or share it.

prompt.prompt: Act as my chief of staff. Here are my notes from this week: [paste notes]. List the five decisions I must make, who should own each one, and a deadline you suggest.

quiz.q: Storyboard18 reports that India's GCCs are offering up to a 40% salary premium for AI talent.
quiz.why: This restates the Storyboard18 headline. It shows that AI skills are in demand and employers are paying more for them.

quiz.q: Tech Wire Asia reports that OpenAI is bringing its AI models to Google Cloud for enterprise customers.
quiz.why: This restates the Tech Wire Asia headline. It suggests companies may get more choice in where they use AI models.

quiz.q: If an AI tool sounds confident, its answer is almost always correct.
quiz.why: AI can give wrong answers in a very confident tone. This is called hallucination. Check important facts before you use them.

quiz.q: You need to know coding to use AI tools well at work.
quiz.why: Most AI tools work with plain language. If you can explain a task clearly in words, you can start using them.

quiz.q: Giving an AI tool clear context in your prompt usually gives you a better answer.
quiz.why: AI works from what you tell it. Details like your goal, your audience and the format you want help it respond well.
